about: The panel3 device of the simulator's catalogue (c/sim/devices.c): three keys on endpoints 4, 5, 6, channels 1, 2, 3, each a full key in CLICK mode. A LOW pin is a press. Each endpoint keeps its OWN event sequence number (01-model-danych.md §3.3), and a press on one key says nothing about the others. `pin` is a list here — one level per input.

steps.note: Click x1 from endpoint 5, its first event
endpoint 6 counts from 0 on its own
